title: docs-drift-check: cap the PR comment above a threshold — a hub-package PR posts an invariant ~106-row list into every subscribed agent session on every push
body:
Filed by the spec-lane PM seat (session `session_01225pUjnCKWqxcc1PeqKFUq`) on maintainer instruction — routing via the standing direct-command channel; ruling quotes below. Unassigned; `domain:devx` per the anchoring rule (landing files are `.github/workflows/docs-drift-check.yml` + possibly `scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs`'s JSON output, general gate tooling).

(Body re-edited once after write-back read: the first save's sanitizer ate three angle-bracket tokens — the details-tag name, the HTML-comment marker, and the base-ref placeholder. Re-spelled without angle brackets; no content change.)

## Problem, measured today (PR #9020)

The Docs Drift Check advisory comment on a `packages/spec`-touching PR lists **106 editable + 7 release-owned rows (~8 KB)**. Because the mapper is package-granular and nearly every hand-written doc references `@objectstack/spec`, that list is **invariant across all spec PRs** — zero per-PR information on the repo's hottest lane. The comment is updated in place on every `synchronize`, and each update is relayed as an event into **every agent session subscribed to the PR** (PM seats, queue steward, dev sessions). Today's cost was 8 KB × 4 events × N subscribers on one PR, before its first review round.

This is the presentation-cap direction (#7009's "direction 2: Cap and summarise"), which #7007 deliberately left un-done ("choosing N and the ranking belongs with whoever owns the granularity question"). It changes **nothing about what is computed** — so it does not contradict `affected-docs.mjs`'s stated over-inclusion principle, which was the ground for closing the edge-granularity question (#7009, not planned, 2026-08-12). #7009's restart condition ("the first measured review burden — a seat reports acting on (or skipping) a wrong advisory list") fired today in the maintainer's own words, but the edge-granularity subject stays closed; this card is presentation only.

## Change

In `docs-drift-check.yml`'s comment step (all numbers current as of today — re-derive at claim time):

- **If `editable.length` exceeds N (suggested default N=15; dev may tune with a measurement)**: post NO list. One summary line — count, the changed package names, and the runnable re-derivation (`node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json origin/BASE_REF`) — plus ONE line for the release-owned subset ("K release-owned pages also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails").
- **If `editable.length` is at or under N**: current full-list rendering, unchanged (small-package PRs keep the actionable short list — measured: an `@objectstack/client` JSDoc edit lists 11).
- ⛔ No details-tag folding as the mechanism — collapsing rows behind an HTML disclosure element does not reduce what the event relay delivers to agent sessions; the tokens are spent regardless. The cap must actually omit the rows.
- Keep unchanged: the `docs-drift-check` HTML-comment marker (in-place update dedup), the benign "0 changed package(s) ✅" comment, the mapper self-test step, and the release-owned partition **semantics** (#6893/#4920 — the subset stays computed and stays flagged read-only; only its rendering compresses above the threshold). The `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow is unaffected — it recomputes from `affected-docs.mjs`, never from this comment.

## Provenance (maintainer, 2026-08-16, in-session with the spec-seat PM, verbatim, untranslated)

- 「这个是不是浪费 token， 应该关了。 每张 spec PR 的例行 advisory(106 页「可能需要复核」的提示 + releases 页只读警示)」
- PM analysis offered: threshold truncation / full off / hub-package silence. Maintainer chose threshold truncation and ordered the card: 「立」.
- Context: the maintainer separately disabled the Vercel PR comments (dashboard toggle) in the same conversation — this card is the remaining half of the PR-comment token-burn cleanup.

## Size/model suggestion

S, sonnet — mechanical workflow-script edit; the judgment (cap vs off vs granularity) is already ruled above.

## Lineage

#6893 (headline noise, fixed by #7007) → #7009 (edge granularity, closed not planned — stays closed) → #8771 (recall blind spot, documented limitation) → this card (presentation cap, maintainer-ruled).
